claudeDispatchBlocker: No Claude CLI in the current execution environment; browser is at Claude sign-in. No session/job receipt exists.

orders.title: Build runnable web mixer shell with Fostex-inspired channel strips
orders.gate: None beyond prerequisites and successful development validation.
implementation: Audit the current React shell against this story; reuse the merged implementation rather than scaffold a second app.
Check console/network errors, empty-state accessibility and disabled future processors. Capture the exact tested commit and current smaller-window behavior.
scenarios: Clean session → open the app at 1280×720 and 1440×900 → named Transport/Tracks/Master/Mixer regions and Import appear, without runtime errors.
Inspect unavailable processing controls → they remain disabled and clearly labeled until their real engine implementation lands.

orders.title: Import WAV audio and display a track in the mixer
orders.sprint: Unscheduled foundation work; do not assign a sprint silently.
orders.gate: None beyond prerequisites and successful development validation.
implementation: Retain local WAV import, the current 100 MiB boundary and decoded-rate labeling; browser AudioContext can resample.

Cover RIFF/WAVE header validation, valid-header/invalid-payload decode errors, replacement failure, same-file reimport and overlapping-load lifecycle. Do not implement drag/drop unless separately justified by the story.
scenarios: Import a synthetic PCM16 44.1 kHz WAV → correct name, channels, decoded duration/rate and Ready appear.
While a valid track exists, replace it with valid-header undecodable audio → actionable error; previous track remains usable.
Try empty, wrong extension, disguised/corrupt data and documented size boundaries → recoverable rejection; a later valid import succeeds.

orders.title: Implement real Play/Pause transport for imported WAV
orders.sprint: Unscheduled foundation work; do not assign a sprint silently.
orders.gate: None beyond prerequisites and successful development validation.
implementation: Keep engine-owned source/context lifecycle and user-gesture playback. Existing unit tests check saved offset and stop reset; visible status alone does not prove output timing.

Reconcile the existing comment requesting elapsed time/playhead: add a minimal real engine time display if needed to satisfy observability, without treating a full waveform editor as already implemented.
scenarios: Known recognizable track → Play to a marked segment → Pause, wait, Play → resumes from the stored position.
Stop then Play → starts at zero; natural end resets to the documented state.
Rapid actions and a failed replacement decode → no overlapping sources, stale onended callback or UI freeze.

orders.title: Set up Playwright JS and first browser smoke tests
orders.gate: None beyond prerequisites and successful development validation.
implementation: Preserve the JavaScript Playwright/Vitest setup and existing tests. Map TC-001 to LAS-53 and valid-WAV TC-002 to LAS-57; do not create duplicate test cases.
Keep role/label locators, synthetic fixtures, real expected states and beginner-readable comments. Do not weaken geometry assertions. Document HTML ZIP, trace and exact run commands.

Reconcile README port 5174 with current Playwright 5173. Prove which checkout owns the server when reuseExistingServer is true. CI is proposed as a separate follow-on in the original AC, not a fabricated existing workflow.
scenarios: Run the current suite against the intended commit/server → report actual pass/fail/skip and environment.
Trigger a controlled assertion failure on a throwaway test branch → actionable trace/screenshot/HTML report, without altering product expectations to make it green.
Map each browser assertion to the source manual case and give Gennady the command and report path.

orders.title: Resume paused audio with either Pause or Play
orders.sprint: Unscheduled foundation work; do not assign a sprint silently.
orders.gate: None beyond prerequisites and successful development validation.
implementation: Make Pause toggle playing↔paused using the real engine; Play must also resume from pause. Keep Stop resetting to zero.
Use explicit transport state and guards for pending resume/load operations; repeated gestures must never create two active sources.
scenarios: Playing → Pause → Pause → resumes at the same offset.
Playing → Pause → Play → resumes at the same offset.
Repeated toggles and Stop → no overlapping playback; empty/decoding controls stay consistent.

orders.title: Unload the imported track and return the mixer to its empty state
orders.sprint: Unscheduled foundation work; do not assign a sprint silently.
orders.gate: None beyond prerequisites and successful development validation.
implementation: Add one accessible Remove track/Unload action for the current single-track session. Implement engine unload distinct from permanent engine disposal.
Stop/disconnect active nodes, clear decoded buffer/metadata/offset and invalidate pending loads so removed audio cannot reappear. Preserve the source file.
scenarios: Unload while Playing, Paused and Stopped → silence, empty metadata, zero position and empty-state controls.
Unload during an in-flight replacement when the action is supported → a late decode cannot restore the removed track.
Reimport the same WAV and a different WAV → normal playback, with resources released and original bytes unchanged.

orders.title: Choose authentication architecture and define account/session flows
orders.gate: None beyond prerequisites and successful development validation.
implementation: Inspect the repository: it is currently a local browser app with no auth backend. Add a concrete ADR before introducing the backend/provider boundary.

Prefer a runnable development environment with verification/recovery test mail; document provider costs, production credentials and deployment as external setup blockers. No fake localStorage authentication.
Keep guest/local playback runnable and testable without a paid provider.
scenarios: Follow the ADR setup from clean configuration → local guest playback works and chosen development auth is reproducible.
Review the endpoint/session matrix → anonymous, verified owner, unverified and expired/revoked sessions have explicit rules.

orders.title: Define privacy rules, data lifecycle and threat model for studio assets
orders.gate: None beyond prerequisites and successful development validation.
implementation: Inventory source audio, references, stems, profiles, projects, jobs, exports, logs and backups. Document local/server/external trust boundaries and ownership.
Specify retention and deletion propagation, backup expiry, opt-in consent and a verifiable local-only no-upload mode before enabling storage.
scenarios: Trace import→analysis→preview→export in local-only mode → no audio network transmission.
Review threat scenarios → takeover, ID guessing, shared links, parser abuse, logs and backups each have a control and a test owner.

orders.title: Add registration, verified login and logout to the studio
orders.gate: None beyond prerequisites and successful development validation.
implementation: Implement registration/verification/login/logout with the LAS-19 decision and development mail infrastructure. Server/provider validates sessions.
Separate backend-enforced auth from route presentation; redact credentials/tokens from all test traces and logs. Keep guest audio available according to ADR.
scenarios: Register a new test account → verify email → valid login grants the intended access.
Invalid credentials/unverified login → safe errors and no protected access.
Logout → old session fails direct protected API requests as well as UI routing.

orders.title: Add password recovery, session expiry and authentication abuse controls
orders.gate: None beyond prerequisites and successful development validation.
implementation: Use provider-backed recovery, bounded token lifetime/single use, session revocation policy and tested rate limits.
Test time deterministically where possible; do not use long sleeps or expose account existence in recovery responses.
scenarios: Reset with a valid token → password changes and old sessions obey the documented revocation rule.
Expired, reused or forged token → denied; repeated attempts → throttled with a safe recovery path.
Expired session during a protected operation → clear state, no data leak or false save success.

orders.title: Enforce private audio storage, ownership checks and safe uploads
orders.gate: None beyond prerequisites and successful development validation.
implementation: Enforce owner checks for every operation on projects/audio/references/stems/jobs/exports. Use private storage and scoped expiring downloads.
Validate actual file content/size and isolate parsing with time/memory bounds. Test API/storage access independently of the UI.
scenarios: Account B guesses A’s IDs for list/read/write/delete/process/download → every unauthorized operation fails.
Anonymous and expired signed-link access → rejected under policy.
Disguised, malformed, oversized and path-manipulating uploads → rejected; valid authorized upload still succeeds.

orders.title: Add project/account deletion and explicit external-processing consent
orders.gate: None beyond prerequisites and successful development validation.
implementation: Make project/account deletion propagate to derived audio, jobs, metadata and access permissions according to the LAS-20 policy.
Require recipient/location-specific consent before external transmission; cancellation before upload must send no audio. Do not auto-enable an external service for convenience.
scenarios: Delete a disposable project → source/derived access revoked and applicable jobs cancelled.
Delete a test account → purge/backup-expiry behavior and exceptions match policy.
Cancel or withhold external-processing consent → network evidence shows zero audio upload.

orders.title: Verify authentication, cross-user isolation and sensitive-data handling
orders.gate: None beyond prerequisites and successful development validation.
implementation: Create a two-account authorization matrix and direct API/storage regression suite alongside UI coverage.
Inspect sanitized bundles, logs, artifacts, dependency/configuration results; classify findings and exact limits. This technical validation is not Gennady’s later manual sign-off.
scenarios: Run anonymous/owner/other-user/expired-session matrix for each operation → expected allow/deny results with evidence.
Repeat logout/reset, invalid upload, deletion and consent tests → no regressions and no secrets in artifacts.

orders.title: Analyze WAV loudness, true peaks, spectrum, dynamics and stereo behavior
orders.gate: None beyond prerequisites and successful development validation.
implementation: Build actual analysis with algorithm/version/sample-rate/segment metadata; workers or a documented non-blocking path handle long data.
Validate integrated loudness, sample peak, oversampled true peak, dynamics, spectrum and stereo indicators against independent fixtures/tools. Define silence/mono/unsupported states.
scenarios: Silence, tones, impulses, mono/stereo, clipped and intersample-peak fixtures → finite, correctly labeled values within declared tolerances.
Analyze a representative long WAV → UI stays usable; cancel/retry and corrupt input recover safely.
Compare an identical file/segment twice → reproducible measurements; source hash unchanged.

orders.title: Implement a reproducible EQ, compressor and limiter processing chain
orders.gate: None beyond prerequisites and successful development validation.
implementation: Create a versioned parameter schema and a validated EQ→compressor→limiter chain with documented preview/offline semantics. Do not turn unavailable controls into decorations.

Preserve the user-requested 24 independent parametric bands per L and per R, Left/Right/Link, 20 Hz–min(20 kHz,0.45×sampleRate), gain/Q/type. See REQUIREMENT_RECONCILIATION.md; introduce in small testable slices within this task.

Use stable/smoothed parameters and a verified transfer response, not a Gaussian UI curve. Characterize compressor timing and limiter latency/oversampled true-peak detection. Optional reverb/saturation remain deferred by this ticket.
scenarios: Change one left-channel EQ band → measured left response changes; right response stays unchanged; Link edits both according to documented semantics.
Impulse/sweep/level-step fixtures → response, attack/release, limiter ceiling, latency, bypass and no-NaN guards pass at supported sample rates.
Serialize/reload the chain → same parameters and deterministic output within tolerance.

orders.title: Add editable mastering controls, level-matched A/B and processed WAV export
orders.gate: None beyond prerequisites and successful development validation.
implementation: Connect editable controls to the real LAS-27 parameter model; implement per-module bypass, undo, saved snapshots and position-preserving level-matched original/processed A/B.
Expose the interactive 24-band L/R/Link EQ with drag Frequency/Gain, Q control, numeric/keyboard editing and real response plot. Live spectrum must measure actual samples.

Export actual processed 24-bit PCM WAV using equivalent offline DSP; record sample rate/channels/bit depth, render cancellation/tail/latency/dither policy. Independently inspect duration/header/peaks/parity.
scenarios: Drag/numerically edit an EQ point and Q at supported sizes → correct engine parameter/channel; keyboard access works; undo restores prior state.
Toggle original/processed at the same musical position → documented constant gain matching and no unexpected state reset.
Export then independently decode/analyze → valid processed WAV, expected duration/channels/rate/depth, original unchanged and preview/export parity within tolerance.

orders.title: Establish DSP regression fixtures and a mastering listening-review protocol
orders.gate: None beyond prerequisites and successful development validation.
implementation: Create deterministic synthetic DSP fixtures and an independent measurement/parity harness. Record the actual algorithms/tolerances and golden versioning policy.

Prepare a matched-loudness listening protocol for Gennady. Lia v6 is an approved sonic target; obtain the real authorized file/checksum before matching. Historical loudness figures are not measurements of current files.
scenarios: Run filter/compressor/limiter/mono/correlation/parity fixtures → measured outputs and explicit tolerances, including negative tests.
Prepare original/processed/reference listening examples → same segment/time alignment, documented constant gain, blind labels if feasible; human verdict remains Not Run until listened.

orders.title: Import reference audio and save versioned sound profiles
orders.gate: None beyond prerequisites and successful development validation.
implementation: Import an owner-private reference, choose a segment and store versioned measured profiles with file identity/checksum, analysis version and units.
Persist profile metadata and file ownership/deletion behavior with LAS-23; keep styles/versions separate and handle silence/invalid segments.
scenarios: Import reference and select segment → profile identifies exact source/segment and actual measurements.
Reanalyze unchanged file/segment → stable profile within tolerance; other user cannot access it.
Delete source/project according to policy → no orphan accessible reference derivatives.

orders.title: Compare a mix with its reference at matched loudness
orders.gate: None beyond prerequisites and successful development validation.
implementation: Compare matched source/reference segments using the LAS-26/30 metrics and LAS-28 monitor path. Keep comparison separate from processing.
Display units, uncertainty and unsupported conditions. Selecting a reference must not silently alter audio.
scenarios: Switch comparable source/reference segments → measured spectral/dynamic/stereo differences and level-matched monitor.
Different lengths, mono/stereo and silent segments → honest supported/unsupported outcomes with no divide-by-zero.
Select another reference → no DSP parameters change until a proposal is explicitly applied.

orders.title: Generate and apply an explainable reference-guided mastering proposal
orders.gate: None beyond prerequisites and successful development validation.
implementation: Derive a bounded explainable parameter proposal from actual measured differences and the validated processors, with editable strength and rationale per module.
Preview/reduce/edit/reject/undo the whole chain, preserve original and accepted baseline, and do not pretend to recover proprietary mastering settings.
scenarios: Measured source/reference pair → reproducible recipe with numeric settings, reasons and uncertainty.
Adversarial tonal/width/dynamics differences → boost/compression/mono/headroom guards bound the proposal.
Reject/undo → previous complete chain restored; listening improvement is recorded only after a real matched comparison.

orders.title: Save mastering preferences and reusable reference-based presets
orders.gate: None beyond prerequisites and successful development validation.
implementation: Persist versioned presets/preferences, rename/apply/export/delete and migration/invalid-data handling under owner control. Include all 24 EQ bands per channel.
Separate reference targets from explicit user preferences and accepted/rejected variants. Do not silently train/upload music.
scenarios: Save customized chain→reload→apply → complete state restored, including L/R/Link bands and chain order.
Import old/invalid/newer schema → documented migration or actionable rejection without corrupting the current project.
Reset preference influence → reference target retained; other-user access denied.

orders.title: Import original stems and play them through synchronized mixer channels
orders.gate: None beyond prerequisites and successful development validation.
implementation: Use a shared audio clock and explicit offset/sample-rate/length policy for aligned stems. Reuse current transport state and resource cleanup.
Add per-channel gain/pan/mute/solo with actual individual/master metering and no accumulating drift. Include seek as required by this ticket, without claiming a full DAW.
scenarios: Aligned known impulses/stems → simultaneous start/pause/resume/seek/stop and measured alignment after repeated operations.
Adjust gain/pan/mute/solo → only intended routing changes; expected summing and mono behavior.
Mismatched rate/offset/length and reimport/unload → explicit policy, no silent timing shift or regression in single-track flows.

orders.title: Process individual stems and render a synchronized stem master
orders.gate: None beyond prerequisites and successful development validation.
implementation: Route independent versioned stem processing through the master chain. Measure and compensate processor latency; preserve original alignment and recall.
Define combined/per-stem export headroom, tails, clipping and error recovery rather than silently normalizing every stem.
scenarios: Different chains on vocal/drums/bass fixtures → only intended channels change; bypass and recall are repeatable.
Latency-inducing processing → sample alignment preserved in monitored and offline summed output.
Render supported combined/per-stem WAVs → expected duration/rate/channels and routing, unchanged source bytes.

orders.title: Evaluate AI stem separation quality, runtime and deployment options
orders.gate: None beyond prerequisites and successful development validation.
implementation: Compare at least two feasible authorized source-separation approaches when resources allow, with licenses, model versions, hardware/runtime/memory and privacy/cost assumptions.
Use available ground-truth stems for residual comparisons; record bleed, transients, warble, phase/mono and recombination. Deliver go/no-go plus scoped next step, not an invented production feature.
scenarios: Authorized mixture and known stems → run feasible candidates; record actual runtime and artifacts or precise resource blockers.
Matched listening/numerical comparison → limitations and go/no-go; unexecuted comparisons remain Not Run.

orders.title: Design and evaluate a native VST3/AU host bridge for the web studio
orders.gate: None beyond prerequisites and successful development validation.
implementation: Inspect native code availability: current main has historical JUCE documents, not a working native host. Keep the browser app intact.
Evaluate an authenticated local host bridge, discovery, parameter/state control, crash/resource containment, formats/architectures/licenses and preview/export parity with a permitted plugin.
If macOS/AU, SDK/plugin or host build is unavailable, deliver design/prototype evidence for the feasible subset and explicit blockers; no support claim from a diagram.
scenarios: Permitted plugin on available platform → actual routed processing and parameter/state evidence, or exact unexecuted blocker.
Unauthorized bridge client and host/plugin crash → isolation/control design and executable evidence where available; no loss of source/project.

orders.title: Prototype application-controlled plugin processing after host feasibility passes
orders.gate: A positive LAS-37 decision and a permitted available plugin/host are required.
implementation: Run only after a positive LAS-37 feasibility decision and available permitted plugin/host. Otherwise deliver a documented Blocked result and the scoped plan.
Prototype app-controlled selection/parameters/state/bypass, numerical processing, missing/crash handling and authenticated bridge; no arbitrary plugin installation/purchase.
scenarios: Supported test plugin→process known fixture→save/reload parameters → measurable change and recall.
Missing/incompatible/crashing plugin or unauthorized client → safe denial/recovery, preserved project and stated parity limits.

orders.title: Assess training a separate audio model from references and user feedback
orders.gate: None beyond prerequisites and successful development validation.
implementation: Separate profile extraction, preference rules, parameter prediction, style transfer and actual model training. Start with data permissions and leakage-safe train/validation/test protocol.
Compare a small deterministic/reference-matching baseline when feasible; report data/compute blockers honestly. Deliver quality/cost/privacy go/no-go, not production training.
scenarios: Review data inventory/splits → provenance/permissions and leakage checks recorded before experiments.
Run feasible baseline/held-out evaluation → measured performance and listening status, or precise Not Run blockers with resource assumptions.

orders.title: Audit the prototype UI and agree the studio's visual direction with Gennady
orders.gate: Preserve the explicit Gennady design/review gate from Jira. Prepare the artifact, record Pending, and continue unrelated ready work; do not invent user approval.
implementation: Audit current screens/workflows with reproduction context and prepare a design brief. The accepted LAS-51 responsive patch does not approve the final visual theme.

Offer at least two distinct directions when references do not already determine one; prepare reviewable local/browser artifacts and record Gennady’s real choice when supplied. Continue independent backend/DSP work while choice is pending.
scenarios: Review audit at baseline/compact viewports → concrete hierarchy/readability/control issues and annotated screenshots.
Compare proposed directions and brief → user choice is recorded or explicitly Pending; no invented approval.

orders.title: Design studio navigation and interactive wireframes for the core user journeys
orders.gate: Preserve the explicit Gennady design/review gate from Jira. Prepare the artifact, record Pending, and continue unrelated ready work; do not invent user approval.
implementation: Build information architecture and a clickable prototype covering project/audio/reference/stem/export and account/privacy journeys, using LAS-19/20 rules.
Cover all loading/error/unsaved/empty/play/paused/export states. Present for Gennady’s walkthrough; do not let a missing walkthrough block independent DSP work.
scenarios: Walk import→play→analysis→reference→export and account recovery → navigation/state/error paths understandable in a clickable artifact.
Pending feedback stays Pending; decisions are recorded before declaring design accepted.

orders.title: Create a design system and approved high-fidelity studio screen designs
orders.gate: Preserve the explicit Gennady design/review gate from Jira. Prepare the artifact, record Pending, and continue unrelated ready work; do not invent user approval.
implementation: Specify tokens/components/accessibility/keyboard behavior and high-fidelity screens based on the chosen LAS-42/43 direction.

Document width/height rules, breakpoint boundaries, zoom/DPI, real control hit areas and 24-band EQ pointer mapping. Gennady’s explicit visual approval is a gate for final reskin, not for existing responsive maintenance.
scenarios: Inspect default/hover/focus/disabled/error/loading states and key screens → complete reusable specifications at agreed viewports.
Review approval record → accepted design version identified, or Pending with independent work continuing.

orders.title: Implement the approved studio shell, mixer controls and shared account components
orders.gate: Preserve the explicit Gennady design/review gate from Jira. Prepare the artifact, record Pending, and continue unrelated ready work; do not invent user approval.
implementation: Implement approved shell/account/shared controls; preserve accessible names and real engine behavior. Reuse LAS-48 responsive layout rather than writing an unrelated second layout.
Start final reskin after LAS-44 approval. Functional nonvisual controls can proceed under their own tickets; do not silently treat existing prototype or an agent’s mockup as approved.
scenarios: Approved designs vs actual shell at supported sizes → critical controls fit and component states match.
Keyboard/pointer faders and transport/import/Pause toggle/unload → existing behavior and state persist through navigation/resize.

orders.title: Implement the approved mastering, reference, stem and export workflows
orders.gate: Preserve the explicit Gennady design/review gate from Jira. Prepare the artifact, record Pending, and continue unrelated ready work; do not invent user approval.
implementation: Integrate working analysis/EQ/dynamics/reference/proposals/stems/export into the approved navigation and shared components.
Keep original/processed/reference identity, level matching, undo, progress/errors and supported local/external boundaries visible to users.
scenarios: Import→analyze→proposal→edit/undo→reference A/B→stem mix→export → correct actual engine state and clear completion/error feedback.
Cancel/retry/return to project → recoverable workflow, no lost source/settings/playback state.

orders.title: Review usability, accessibility and visual consistency across the redesigned studio
orders.gate: Preserve the explicit Gennady design/review gate from Jira. Prepare the artifact, record Pending, and continue unrelated ready work; do not invent user approval.
implementation: Run task-based accessibility, keyboard/focus/contrast/target and visual consistency checks against the approved brief.
Stabilize/mask only real dynamic time/meters in snapshots; verify continuous resize, 100/125/200% zoom, breakpoints and manual DPI checks. Gennady’s final review is not prefilled by Claude.
scenarios: Perform representative complete journeys using keyboard and pointer → usable focus/names/errors with no critical overlap/clipping.
Compare screenshots across states/sizes → static differences reviewed; Gennady’s verdict and open defects recorded after actual review.

orders.title: Make the studio workspace responsive to window and screen resizing
orders.gate: LAS-44 does not block the urgent current-layout verification; see the explicit waiver in the source issue. Final redesign remains subject to approved design.
implementation: Keep the accepted PR #8 layout. LAS-50/51 are Done; do not restart their rejected alternatives or broaden a spacing preference into a confirmed bug.

Use 761×450 desktop lower boundary and ≤760 stacked scrolling behavior from closure evidence; expand tests for source LAS-48 criteria still uncovered: zoom/DPI, new waveform/EQ/meters/settings, additional browser/manual checks.

The native LAS-44 Blocks link is stale for the urgent existing-layout fix: its description explicitly waives that dependency. Preserve and explain the distinction; no need to wait for a full redesign to verify the current patch.
scenarios: Empty/loaded/error/long name → 817×598→785×520 without reload/scroll; essential controls visible, hit-testable and separated.
Continuous width/height and 760/761/762 breakpoint crossings → no forbidden desktop scrolling; stacked behavior remains deliberate.
Resize while playing and after future controls are added → actual audio/position/settings persist; record listening/DPI/browser limits.

orders.title: Test plan — LAS-48 responsive workspace (24 test cases)
orders.sprint: Unscheduled foundation work; do not assign a sprint silently.
orders.gate: None beyond prerequisites and successful development validation.
implementation: Preserve the original 24 manual cases and trace them to current implementations/automated tests. Treat the old header saying only four issue types exist as historical: native Test Plan/Case/Execution types now exist.
Map historical passing coverage from LAS-50/51 to exact builds; do not automatically mark the 24 cases Pass. Future EQ/stem/hardware cases remain Blocked/Not Run until executable.
scenarios: Reconcile all 24 source case IDs → each has build/environment/status/evidence or explicit blocker.
Compare source acceptance matrix to current tests → remaining gaps and planned test owners visible, without duplicate test cases.

orders.title: LAS-10-TC-002: Verify that a valid WAV file is imported successfully
orders.gate: None beyond prerequisites and successful development validation.
implementation: Reuse LAS-57 as TC-002 under LAS-10/LAS-52; implement or map a focused valid-WAV test using tests/fixtures/wav.js.

Preserve its real expected rule: Play and Stop enabled in Ready, Pause disabled until playback. Decoded sample rate may be resampled; verify decoded metadata honestly. Manual execution belongs to Gennady later.
scenarios: Clean empty session→import LAS-TC002-tone.wav (3s mono PCM16 44.1 kHz) → Ready, 01 TRACK, filename/duration/decoded metadata, Replace WAV.
Inspect Ready controls → Play/Stop enabled, Pause disabled; no alert. Record automated run separately from manual Not Run.
